ldap_uris.description: List of LDAP server URIs to connect to. Supports ldap://, ldaps://, and ldap+dns:// schemes.

ldap_base.description: Default base DN for LDAP searches (e.g., users, groups).

ldap_bind_dn.description: DN to bind as for authenticated searches. Leave empty for anonymous bind.

ldap_bind_pw.description: Password for the bind DN. Only used if ldap_bind_dn is set.

ldap_scope.description: Default search scope: one, sub, or base.

tls_cacertdir.description: Directory containing CA certificates for TLS verification (e.g., /etc/ssl/certs).

tls_cacertfile.description: File containing CA certificate(s) for TLS verification.

timelimit.description: Time limit (in seconds) for the entire LDAP operation (server-side and client-side).

scope_search_timeout.description: Time limit (in seconds) per individual LDAP search request.

reconnect_retry.description: Retry intervals (in seconds) on connection failure: initial, max, backoff factor, and max total.

nss_map_passwd.default: uid uidNumber cn gecos homeDirectory loginShell
nss_map_passwd.description: NSS passwd map: which LDAP attributes to map to passwd fields.

nss_map_group.description: NSS group map: which LDAP attributes to map to group fields.

nss_map_shadow.description: NSS shadow map: attributes for shadow entries (if enabled).

user_filter.description: Additional LDAP filter for passwd lookups (inside parentheses).

group_filter.description: Additional LDAP filter for group lookups.

shadow_filter.description: Additional LDAP filter for shadow lookups.

pam_login_attribute.description: Attribute used to map PAM login names to LDAP entries.

pam_filter.description: Additional PAM search filter (e.g., to restrict auth to specific users).

nss_initgroups_ignoreusers.description: List of users for which initgroups() lookups should be skipped.

nss_min_uid.description: Minimum UID to include in NSS (prevents system accounts from being overwritten).

nss_max_uid.description: Maximum UID to include (0 = unlimited). Useful to exclude special ranges.

k5start_start.description: Whether to force starting k5start ("yes" to enable, anything else disables).

k5start_keytab.description: Path to the Kerberos keytab file for k5start.

k5start_ccrefresh.description: Ticket refresh interval (in seconds) for k5start.

k5start_principal.description: Kerberos principal for k5start. Can include shell variable substitutions like $(hostname -f).
